description.zh: 待删除快照对应的 LSN。
description.en: The LSN of the snapshot to delete.

description.zh: 地域 ID。用于限定查询或操作所在地域。
description.en: The region ID. Specifies the region in which to query or perform the operation.

descriptions.zh: 该接口用于按 ProjectId 和 Lsn 删除指定 Supabase 项目中的快照。
descriptions.en: Deletes a snapshot from a specified Supabase project by ProjectId and Lsn.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb delete-snapshot --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --project-id spb-xxxx --lsn 0/3522648 --region cn-hangzhou
